thedotmack/claude-mem.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

tirth8205/code-review-graph.description: Local-first code intelligence graph for MCP and CLI. Builds a persistent map of your codebase so AI coding tools read only what matters, with benchmarked context reductions on reviews and large-repo workflows.

coderamp-labs/gitingest.description: Replace 'hub' with 'ingest' in any GitHub URL to get a prompt-friendly extract of a codebase

zilliztech/claude-context.description: Code search MCP for Claude Code. Make entire codebase the context for any coding agent.

yvgude/lean-ctx.description: Control what your AI can see. LeanCTX (Lean Context) is the context intelligence layer for AI agents — one local Rust binary that decides what they read, remembers what they learn, guards what they touch, and proves what they save. 60–90% fewer tokens as the receipt. 76 MCP tools, 30+ agents, local-first.

cocoindex-io/cocoindex-code.description: A super light-weight embedded code search engine CLI (AST based) that just works - saves 70% token and improves speed for coding agent  🌟 Star if you like it!

open-compress/claw-compactor.description: 14-stage Fusion Pipeline for LLM token compression — reversible compression, AST-aware code analysis, intelligent content routing. Zero LLM inference cost. MIT licensed.

jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp.description: Cut AI token costs 95%+ on code exploration. The leading MCP server for precise, symbol-level GitHub code retrieval via tree-sitter AST. Works with Claude Code, Cursor & any MCP client. 313B+ tokens saved.
